hook: Fifteen questions, no second chances. Can you score fifteen out of fifteen? Let us find out.

questions.question: How many bones does an adult human body have?
questions.question_speech: Question one. How many bones does an adult human body have? A. 206. B. 250. C. 180. D. 300.

questions.question: Which organ pumps blood around the body?
questions.question_speech: Question two. Which organ pumps blood around the body? A. Liver. B. Lungs. C. Heart. D. Stomach.

questions.question: What is the largest organ of the human body?
questions.question_speech: Question three. What is the largest organ of the human body? A. Skin. B. Liver. C. Brain. D. Heart.

questions.question: How many chambers does the human heart have?
questions.question_speech: Question four. How many chambers does the human heart have? A. Two. B. Three. C. Five. D. Four.

questions.question: Which organs do we use to breathe?
questions.question_speech: Question five. Which organs do we use to breathe? A. Kidneys. B. Lungs. C. Liver. D. Stomach.

questions.question: Which vitamin does the body make from sunlight?
questions.question_speech: Question six. Which vitamin does the body make from sunlight? A. Vitamin C. B. Vitamin A. C. Vitamin D. D. Vitamin B.

questions.question: How many teeth does a full adult set have?
questions.question_speech: Question seven. How many teeth does a full adult set have? A. 28. B. 30. C. 36. D. 32.

questions.question: Which blood cells carry oxygen around the body?
questions.question_speech: Question eight. Which blood cells carry oxygen around the body? A. White blood cells. B. Red blood cells. C. Platelets. D. Plasma.
questions.answer_speech: B is correct, red blood cells.

questions.question: Which is the longest bone in the human body?
questions.question_speech: Question nine. Which is the longest bone in the human body? A. Femur. B. Tibia. C. Humerus. D. Spine.

questions.question: Which organs filter waste from the blood?
questions.question_speech: Question ten. Which organs filter waste from the blood? A. Lungs. B. Intestines. C. Kidneys. D. Stomach.

questions.question: What is the hardest substance in the human body?
questions.question_speech: Question eleven. What is the hardest substance in the human body? A. Bone. B. Tooth enamel. C. Nail. D. Cartilage.

questions.question: Which part of the eye gives it its color?
questions.question_speech: Question twelve. Which part of the eye gives it its color? A. Pupil. B. Cornea. C. Retina. D. Iris.

questions.question: What is the smallest bone in the human body?
questions.question_speech: Question thirteen. What is the smallest bone in the human body? A. Stapes in the ear. B. Kneecap. C. Rib. D. Finger bone.
questions.answer_speech: A is correct, the stapes in the ear.

questions.question: What is normal human body temperature?
questions.question_speech: Question fourteen. What is normal human body temperature? A. About 30 degrees Celsius. B. About 42 degrees Celsius. C. About 37 degrees Celsius. D. About 25 degrees Celsius.
questions.answer_speech: C is correct, about 37 degrees Celsius.

questions.question: How many senses are traditionally taught?
questions.question_speech: Question fifteen. How many senses are traditionally taught? A. Four. B. Five. C. Six. D. Seven.
